  }),

  invoice: defineTable({
    archive: v.string(), // reference -> re-key to v.id(...)

    oldRef: v.string(), // reference -> re-key to v.id(...)
    oldTotal: v.float64(),

    total: v.float64(),
    bubbleId: v.string(), // primary key (Bubble _id, text)
  }),

  retired: defineTable({
    bubbleId: v.string(), // primary key (Bubble _id, text)
    dbValue: v.string(),
    deleted: v.string(),
    sortFactor: v.float64(),
  }),
});
